items.headline: Clark Lea names Jared Curtis Vanderbilt's starting QB
items.description: Ahead of the Commodores' Week 3 matchup against NC State, Lea explains why five-star freshman Curtis is ready to embrace the challenge of the starting role.

items.headline: Vanderbilt freshman QB Jared Curtis to start vs. NC State
items.description: Vanderbilt freshman quarterback Jared Curtis will start Saturday against NC State after accounting for three of the Commodores' four touchdowns in last weekend's 35-26 win over Delaware.

items.headline: College Football Playoff 2026: Bubble Watch after Week 2
items.description: Putting the spotlight on select teams and questions around others as the early playoff picture takes shape.

items.headline: Vanderbilt squares off against NC State
items.description: NC State (1-1) at Vanderbilt (2-0), Sept. 19 at 12:45 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Highlight: Vanderbilt wins up-and-down contest vs. Delaware
items.description: The Commodores open a two touchdown lead in the first quarter but go into halftime down a field goal before scoring three TDs to put the game out of reach in the third quarter, 35-26.
